top_choice_rationale: P002 credits a quantitative prediction (Bistritzer and MacDonald's 2011 magic twist angle with flat bands) and its decisive experimental confirmation (Jarillo-Herrero's 2018 correlated insulating and superconducting states), with the twist angle a single parameter that can be set and checked by structural characterisation. Replication across many groups and moire platforms meets the discovery criterion, and a citation limited to the predicted flat bands and observed phases avoids the open pairing mechanism. All three names map onto steps of that chain, whereas P001 leaves the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang HgTe prediction outside its trio. P001 is the safer, more mature second choice, P003 a clean and defensible third, and no award last.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; I note my Chalmers affiliation shared with Goran Johansson, who prefers P001, but no documented tie to any credited name in P001, P002 or P003
